title: RBAC v2 authorization golden validator and CI regression integration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a deterministic validation harness and CI regression job for RBAC v2 that exercises permission evaluation, admin controls, SSO/SAML attribute mappings, and audit log entries using a set of golden fixtures. The goal is to catch regressions in permission semantics (allow/deny), audit metadata completeness, and SSO role mapping changes before they reach production. This will replace several brittle end-to-end smoke tests with a faster, repeatable golden-driven validation flow that runs on every merge to main and nightly against the dedicated test cluster.
updates: 2026-02-20 - Kickoff: aligned with Security and Platform on scope: permission matrix coverage, audit log schema assertions, SAML role mapping scenarios, and admin UI toggles. Decided to focus first on server-side authorization and audit events; admin UI e2e tests will be separate follow-up.

2026-02-26 - Spike complete: developed prototype that loads 'golden fixtures' (YAML) describing principals, resources, actions, expected decision, and expected audit fields. Prototype found a backwards-incompatible decision change for 'dataset.delete' introduced in ENG-7609; filed ENG-7768 to revert the behavioral change.

2026-03-03 - Design review: PM (Leah Chen) and Security (Omar Hassan) reviewed test matrix and approved coverage targets. Agreed on format for golden fixtures and minimal required audit fields: actor_id, actor_email, resource, action, decision, reason, trace_id, timestamp.

2026-03-07 - Implementation: core harness 'rbac-goldens' added to infra/tests with CLI to run against local dev cluster or remote 'test-rbac' environment. Integration with simpleSAMLphp docker image included for SAML flows to validate attribute-to-role mappings.

2026-03-09 - CI integration: draft pipeline job 'ci/rbac-goldens' added to .github/workflows for PR checks. Currently gated to nightly until flakiness is resolved. Flakiness traced to delayed audit log indexing; working with infra to add consistent log flush hook for test env (ENG-7890).

2026-03-12 - Code review feedback: security asked to assert presence of encryption key reference in audit events for admin actions; platform asked to reduce test runtime by parallelizing fixture runs. Addressing both in follow-up commits.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test harness that can load a directory of golden fixtures and evaluate expected permission decisions against RBAC v2 service
Audit log assertions for each golden entry that check required fields (actor_id, resource, action, decision, reason, trace_id) and that logs are emitted within test TTL
SAML attribute mapping scenarios included: (a) direct role attribute, (b) attribute-to-role translation rule, (c) unknown attribute -> fallback role behavior
CI job that runs harness on PRs (fast subset) and nightly (full matrix) with pass/fail gating for permission regressions
Documentation describing golden fixture schema, how to add new fixtures, and debugging steps for failures
test_plan: Golden fixtures format: YAML files with fields: id, description, principal (id/email/attributes), resource, action, expected_decision, expected_audit (key->value assertions)
Runner modes: --live (against running cluster), --replay (mocked evaluator), --ci (minimal subset)
SAML flows: spin up simpleSAMLphp test IdP container and assert login->role mapping ends up with expected Principal attributes in RBAC system
Audit verification: query test index (Elasticsearch) by trace_id and assert schema fields and values; fallback to reading raw log file if indexing lag exceeds TTL
Failure diagnostics: harness emits reproducible curl commands and a minimal reproducer bundle (fixture + trace_id + raw logs) to attach to PRs
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Decision: Use golden fixtures + lightweight runner instead of full browser e2e for authorization checks to keep test runtime low and deterministic.
Tradeoff: This approach tests server-side policy/eval and audit emission but doesn't catch UI misconfigurations; separate UX regression tickets will handle admin console tests.
Decision: Include a local SAML IdP (simpleSAMLphp) for realistic attribute flows rather than fully mocking SSO assertions to capture parsing/mapping regressions.
Tradeoff: Running an IdP adds CI fragility and longer runtime; mitigated by running full SAML scenarios nightly and a reduced mock SAML flow on PRs.
risks_and_mitigation: Flaky audit indexing leads to nondeterministic failures - mitigation: implement explicit log flush hook in test cluster and fall back to raw log read when needed (ENG-7890)
Large golden matrix increases CI time - mitigation: run representative subset on PRs and full matrix nightly with parallelism and early-fail ordering

False confidence if fixtures don't cover edge cases - mitigation: schedule periodic fixture reviews with Security and Product to add high-risk scenarios (admin delegation, cross-tenant resource access)
SAML IdP maintenance burden - mitigation: pin simpleSAMLphp container versions and include health-checks in the harness
notes: Next steps: finish parallelization, implement audit log flush hook, and flip CI job from nightly-only to PR gating for the reduced subset
Longer-term: incorporate admin UI toggles into the golden framework or a companion UI regression suite
Owner: Security-Eng joint; escalate to Platform infra if log indexing latency > 30s in test env
